residencyRequirements.description: Either spouse must be an Australian citizen, domiciled in Australia, or ordinarily resident in Australia for at least 12 months (Family Law Act 1975 (Cth), s.39(3)).

waitingPeriod.description: No waiting period. Divorce Order takes effect 1 month and 1 day after made (s.55).

basic.name: Affidavit — Proof of Separation
basic.description: Required only if the parties were separated under one roof during the 12-month separation (or at the Court's request)

legalCitations.description: Repealed presumption of equal shared parental responsibility (s.61DA); reformed parenting provisions (in force 6 May 2024)
Codified property settlement process (s.79); family violence and wastage factors; companion animal orders; abolished mandatory counselling for marriages under 2 years (in force 10 June 2025)

filingFees.notes: Fee effective 1 July 2025. Reduced fee of AUD $365 available for concession card holders (Health Care Card, Pensioner Concession Card, Commonwealth Seniors Health Card) or parties experiencing financial hardship.

effectiveDateRule: Divorce Order takes effect 1 month and 1 day after made (s.55).
certificateNote: Sealed Divorce Order obtainable from registry after effective date.
